title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
summary: Richard Dawkins explains evolution from the point of view of genes, arguing that organisms are vehicles for self-copying genes. The book also introduces the idea of memes as units of cultural copying.
readIf: you want a clear, influential introduction to gene-centred evolution.
skipIf: you want an up-to-date overview of modern biology or find strong claims off-putting.
